vertical_sweep_argument: For every XY-overlapping earlier part, max Z <= landing Z + 1.8. Only aligned stud tips enter; open receivers have 2.2 mm minimum roof clearance and wider lead-ins. Non-stud solids are below landing Z. Intermediate engagement samples also checked.
hand_access: Assembly order keeps head off until cup and neck are fitted. Keyboard is last with 16 mm clearance from head and 24 mm from monitor. Not a hand/force simulation.
